UC-01-01.title: 📖 [UC-01-01] Sélectionner un patient depuis Maia et lancer une analyse
UC-01-01.body:
Epic: EPIC-01

Preconditions:
- Kiné authentifié
- Patients Maia disponibles (prochains RDV)

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given un kiné authentifié on the home page, When he clicks 'Lancer une analyse', Then a patient selector appears with upcoming appointments
- Given a patient selected, When email and RDV are pre-filled, Then the kiné can edit the email before sending
- Given an analysis created, When the kiné validates, Then the workflow opens on Step 1

UC-01-02.title: 📖 [UC-01-02] Envoyer le questionnaire en amont au patient
UC-01-02.body:
Epic: EPIC-01

Preconditions:
- Analyse créée
- E-mail patient valide

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given an analysis with a valid email, When the kiné sends the questionnaire, Then the email is sent within 5 seconds
- Given the email sent, When the patient receives it, Then it contains a personalized secure link and the questionnaire form
- Given the questionnaire link, When the patient opens it, Then the status updates to 'in_progress' on kiné's side

UC-01-03.title: 📖 [UC-01-03] Suivre le statut de complétion du questionnaire amont
UC-01-03.body:
Epic: EPIC-01

Preconditions:
- Questionnaire envoyé

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a questionnaire sent, When the patient opens the link, Then the status updates to 'in_progress' within 10 seconds
- Given the patient submits the questionnaire, When the kiné refreshes, Then the status is 'completed' and Step 1 is prefilled
- Given a completed questionnaire, When the kiné opens the analysis, Then Step 1 displays a green banner with 'Questionnaire rempli en amont'

UC-01-04.title: 📖 [UC-01-04] Visualiser l'aperçu de l'e-mail et du questionnaire patient
UC-01-04.body:
Epic: EPIC-01

Preconditions:
- Analyse créée

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given the email preview, When the kiné reviews it, Then all placeholders are filled (patient name, RDV date, secure link)
- Given the questionnaire preview, When the kiné clicks on it, Then a modal shows the full 5-block form as the patient will see it
- Given the preview modal, When the kiné simulates completion, Then he can see what the prefilled Step 1 will look like

UC-01-05.title: 📖 [UC-01-05] Gérer les erreurs et reprises d'envoi du questionnaire
UC-01-05.body:
Epic: EPIC-01

Preconditions:
- Envoi questionnaire tentée ou échouée

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given an email send failure, When the kiné retries, Then the system attempts resend with exponential backoff
- Given a max retry limit exceeded, When the kiné sees the error, Then he can contact support or try again later
- Given a successful resend, When the status is updated, Then the timeline shows both attempts in the journal

UC-02-01.title: 📖 [UC-02-01] Saisir le questionnaire général avec 5 blocs et logique conditionnelle
UC-02-01.body:
Epic: EPIC-02

Preconditions:
- Questionnaire accessible (lien sécurisé ou Étape 1 ouverte)
- Formulaire rendu mobile-first

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a patient on the questionnaire form, When he selects 'Oui' for orthèses, Then the fields for duration and reason appear
- Given injuries selected as 'Oui', When he enters injury details, Then each injury has zone, date, and status
- Given the patient saves mid-form, When he closes and reopens, Then all data is recovered exactly as saved
- Given the questionnaire completed, When submitted, Then the data is normalized and ready for Step 2 IA

UC-02-02.title: 📖 [UC-02-02] Valider et soumettre le questionnaire (patient amont)
UC-02-02.body:
Epic: EPIC-02

Preconditions:
- Questionnaire rempli (au moins les champs obligatoires)

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a completed questionnaire, When the patient submits, Then all mandatory fields are validated
- Given a submission with missing mandatory field, When the patient sees the validation error, Then the field is highlighted
- Given a successful submission, When the kiné refreshes, Then the status shows 'Complété' and Step 1 can be opened with prefilled data

UC-02-03.title: 📖 [UC-02-03] Afficher le questionnaire en version mobile avec responsive
UC-02-03.body:
Epic: EPIC-02

Preconditions:
- Questionnaire accessible via mobile (lien sécurisé)

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a mobile viewport (375px), When the questionnaire is loaded, Then all fields are readable and tapable
- Given conditional fields, When the patient toggles a value, Then the new fields appear/disappear smoothly
- Given a mobile keyboard, When the patient types, Then the form doesn't jump, scrolls to focus field

UC-02-04.title: 📖 [UC-02-04] Pré-remplir l'Étape 1 si questionnaire amont complété
UC-02-04.body:
Epic: EPIC-02

Preconditions:
- Questionnaire amont status = 'completed'
- Étape 1 ouverte

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a completed upstream questionnaire, When the kiné opens Step 1, Then all fields are prefilled
- Given the prefilled Step 1, When the kiné clicks the Step 1 banner, Then it displays 'Questionnaire rempli en amont'
- Given prefilled data, When the kiné edits a field, Then the change is tracked (source remains 'patient_amont' but with edits)
- Given Step 1 completed amont, When the progress ring is checked, Then it shows 1/9 (11%)

UC-03-01.title: 📖 [UC-03-01] Générer le pré-profil IA et les questions complémentaires
UC-03-01.body:
Epic: EPIC-03

Preconditions:
- Questionnaire (Étape 1) suffisamment complet (seuil à définir avec kiné)
- Moteur IA disponible

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a completed Step 1, When the kiné accesses Step 2, Then the AI profile is generated within 5 seconds
- Given the suggested questions, When the kiné reviews them, Then each question has a context (justification)
- Given a suggested question, When the kiné removes it, Then it is crossed out or removed from the list

UC-03-02.title: 📖 [UC-03-02] Éditer, valider et retirer les questions suggérées par l'IA
UC-03-02.body:
Epic: EPIC-03

Preconditions:
- Pré-profil et questions générées (UC-03-01)

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a suggested question, When the kiné clicks 'Edit', Then the text becomes editable
- Given an edited question, When saved, Then the modified text is used in the interview frame
- Given a question to remove, When the kiné clicks 'Remove', Then it is no longer part of the interview
- Given the 'Add question' button, When the kiné adds a custom question, Then it appears in the interview frame

UC-03-03.title: 📖 [UC-03-03] Finaliser et valider la trame d'interview
UC-03-03.body:
Epic: EPIC-03

Preconditions:
- Questions éditées/validées/retirées

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a finalized interview frame, When the kiné validates, Then Step 2 is marked done
- Given the completed Step 2, When the progress ring is checked, Then it shows 2/9 (22%)
- Given Step 2 done, When Step 3 opens, Then the interview frame is loaded and ready to use

UC-04-01.title: 📖 [UC-04-01] Conduire l'interview assistée avec prise de notes IA
UC-04-01.body:
Epic: EPIC-04

Preconditions:
- Trame d'interview finalisée (Étape 2)
- Patient présent en consultation

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given an interview session, When the kiné notes the patient's answers, Then the AI offers follow-up suggestions in real-time
- Given a follow-up suggestion, When the kiné ignores it, Then no error occurs and the interview continues
- Given the interview completed, When the kiné saves the notes, Then they are timestamped and traceable

UC-04-02.title: 📖 [UC-04-02] Détecter une blessure et déclencher le diagnostic différentiel
UC-04-02.body:
Epic: EPIC-04

Preconditions:
- Interview en cours
- Patient mentionne une blessure/douleur

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a patient with a knee injury, When the kiné selects the injury zone, Then the corresponding pathology matrix is loaded
- Given the matrix loaded, When the AI generates hypotheses, Then each hypothesis shows its contributing signs
- Given the hypotheses, When ranked, Then the most likely is at the top with highest score

UC-04-03.title: 📖 [UC-04-03] Valider/invalider les hypothèses du diagnostic différentiel
UC-04-03.body:
Epic: EPIC-04

Preconditions:
- Diagnostic différentiel généré (UC-04-02)

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a hypothesis with contributing signs, When the kiné reviews it, Then he can validate or reject it with a reason
- Given a rejected hypothesis, When saved, Then it is marked as rejected (not deleted) for audit trail
- Given all hypotheses validated, When the kiné proceeds, Then the test protocol is adapted (e.g., specific strength test for hips)

UC-04-04.title: 📖 [UC-04-04] Adapter le protocole de tests selon le diagnostic
UC-04-04.body:
Epic: EPIC-04

Preconditions:
- Hypothèses validées

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a validated diagnosis of hip pathology, When the protocol is displayed, Then hip-specific mobility tests are suggested
- Given the suggested tests, When the kiné removes or adds tests, Then the protocol is updated
- Given the adapted protocol, When saved, Then it's applied to Steps 4-7

UC-05-01.title: 📖 [UC-05-01] Importer un fichier de test de force (VALD, Étape 4)
UC-05-01.body:
Epic: EPIC-05

Preconditions:
- Diagnostic validé (Étape 3)
- Fichier VALD disponible (CSV/FIT)

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a VALD CSV file with columns Right/Left/Norm, When uploaded, Then the system parses and displays the metrics within 3 seconds
- Given the metrics displayed, When the kiné checks asymmetry, Then it shows delta % and flag (ok/warn/bad)
- Given a malformed file, When uploaded, Then an error message appears without overwriting existing data

UC-05-02.title: 📖 [UC-05-02] Importer un fichier de test de mobilité (VALD, Étape 5)
UC-05-02.body:
Epic: EPIC-05

Preconditions:
- Fichier VALD mobilité (ForceFrame/HumanTrak) disponible

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a VALD mobility file, When uploaded, Then amplitude values (dorsiflexion, hip extension, etc.) are displayed
- Given the mobility data, When asymmetry is calculated, Then it's compared to norms and flagged

UC-05-03.title: 📖 [UC-05-03] Importer un fichier de test fonctionnel (Vitruve, Étape 6)
UC-05-03.body:
Epic: EPIC-05

Preconditions:
- Fichier Vitruve (sauts, puissance) disponible

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a Vitruve CSV file, When uploaded, Then CMJ height, LSI, and power metrics are extracted and displayed

UC-05-04.title: 📖 [UC-05-04] Importer un fichier de données tapis (Stryd, Étape 7)
UC-05-04.body:
Epic: EPIC-05

Preconditions:
- Fichier Stryd FIT/CSV disponible

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a Stryd FIT file, When uploaded, Then power, cadence, GCT, vertical oscillation, LSS are extracted
- Given the Stryd data, When the kiné reviews it, Then he can see running signature metrics (avg power, cadence, etc.)

UC-05-05.title: 📖 [UC-05-05] Gérer les erreurs et les asymétries dans les imports
UC-05-05.body:
Epic: EPIC-05

Preconditions:
- Import en cours ou échoué

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a malformed file, When uploaded, Then the error message is specific (e.g., 'Missing column: Right')
- Given an asymmetry >15%, When displayed, Then it's flagged in red (bad)
- Given a file import error, When the kiné retries, Then the system doesn't duplicate data

UC-06-01.title: 📖 [UC-06-01] Visionner la vidéo et accéder à la grille d'observation
UC-06-01.body:
Epic: EPIC-06

Preconditions:
- Vidéo uploadée (étape 7)
- Données Stryd disponibles

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a video loaded, When the kiné plays it, Then synchronization with Stryd data (cadence overlay optional)
- Given the observation grid, When the kiné selects a view (frontal/sagittal), Then the grid items are appropriate for that view
- Given a time marker, When the kiné adds it, Then it's linked to the video timecode

UC-06-02.title: 📖 [UC-06-02] Remplir la grille d'observation (10 items, D/G, scoring)
UC-06-02.body:
Epic: EPIC-06

Preconditions:
- Vidéo visionnée, grille accessible

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given the observation grid, When the kiné scores each item as green/orange/red, Then the score is saved
- Given a lateralized item (e.g., knee flexion), When the kiné selects Right, Then he scores right side; repeating for Left
- Given all items scored, When the kiné saves, Then all data is timestamped and ready for the report

UC-06-03.title: 📖 [UC-06-03] Synthétiser les observations et finaliser l'Étape 8
UC-06-03.body:
Epic: EPIC-06

Preconditions:
- Grille remplie

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a filled grid, When the kiné writes a summary, Then it captures the global running pattern
- Given notable asymmetries, When listed, Then they're flagged for the report priority section
- Given Step 8 validated, When the progress ring updates, Then it shows 8/9 (89%)

UC-07-01.title: 📖 [UC-07-01] Générer les deux versions du bilan (patient/expert)
UC-07-01.body:
Epic: EPIC-07

Preconditions:
- Toutes les étapes 1-8 complétées ou suffisantes
- Moteur IA disponible

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given all steps completed, When the kiné opens Step 9, Then both report versions are generated within 10 seconds
- Given the patient report, When displayed, Then key message is prominent, gauges show asymmetries, and action plan is clear
- Given the expert report, When displayed, Then raw metrics, graphs, and technical justifications are visible

UC-07-02.title: 📖 [UC-07-02] Éditer et valider les bilans avant publication
UC-07-02.body:
Epic: EPIC-07

Preconditions:
- Bilans générés

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given an editable report section, When the kiné modifies text, Then the change is saved as draft
- Given the report key message, When the kiné edits it, Then the tone remains appropriate for the target audience
- Given all edits complete, When validation button is clicked, Then status updates to 'validated'

UC-07-03.title: 📖 [UC-07-03] Exporter et publier le bilan en PDF
UC-07-03.body:
Epic: EPIC-07

Preconditions:
- Bilan validé

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a validated report, When export PDF is triggered, Then a PDF file is generated within 5 seconds
- Given the PDF, When opened, Then formatting, images, and colors are preserved
- Given publication, When the patient receives notification, Then the link provides access to the synthetic version only

UC-07-04.title: 📖 [UC-07-04] Tracer les versions du bilan et l'historique d'édition
UC-07-04.body:
Epic: EPIC-07

Preconditions:
- Bilan généré et édité

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a report generated and edited, When the version history is viewed, Then all versions are listed with timestamps
- Given a previous version, When selected, Then the kiné can see what changed

UC-08-01.title: 📖 [UC-08-01] Créer et consulter le dossier patient unique
UC-08-01.body:
Epic: EPIC-08

Preconditions:
- Patient créé

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a patient folder open, When the kiné views the sidebar, Then all patient info and current step are visible
- Given Step 3 done and Step 5 pending, When the stepper is viewed, Then Step 3 is marked done, Step 5 is not yet active
- Given a skipped step, When the stepper is checked, Then it's visually distinct from pending/active/done

UC-08-02.title: 📖 [UC-08-02] Naviguer entre étapes (non-linéaire) et modifier le statut d'avancement
UC-08-02.body:
Epic: EPIC-08

Preconditions:
- Dossier patient ouvert

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given Step 3 done, When the kiné clicks on Step 5, Then Step 5 opens (not Step 4)
- Given an earlier step modified, When saved, Then the progress ring updates accordingly
- Given Step 6 skipped, When the kiné completes Step 5, Then progression jumps to Step 7 (if next unaccessed step)

UC-08-03.title: 📖 [UC-08-03] Afficher l'anneau de progression et le stepper interactif
UC-08-03.body:
Epic: EPIC-08

Preconditions:
- Dossier patient ouvert

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given 3 steps completed, When the progress ring is checked, Then it shows 3/9 (33%) with 1/3 fill
- Given a step clicked on stepper, When the panel opens, Then the ring and stepper sync

UC-09-01.title: 📖 [UC-09-01] Recueillir et valider le consentement patient (RGPD)
UC-09-01.body:
Epic: EPIC-09

Preconditions:
- Patient crée/accède à l'application

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a patient accessing the platform for the first time, When the consent modal appears, Then it's clear and unambiguous
- Given consent accepted, When the patient proceeds, Then data is stored (no data processed before consent)
- Given consent denied, When the patient closes the modal, Then no analysis can proceed

UC-09-02.title: 📖 [UC-09-02] Journaliser toutes les actions et décisions cliniques
UC-09-02.body:
Epic: EPIC-09

Preconditions:
- Analyse en cours

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a kiné validates a hypothesis, When the action is logged, Then the journal shows 'kiné X validated hypothesis Y at [timestamp]'
- Given a file imported, When the journal is checked, Then filename, upload time, and parsed metrics are recorded

UC-09-03.title: 📖 [UC-09-03] Implémenter le chiffrement des données (transit + repos)
UC-09-03.body:
Epic: EPIC-09

Preconditions:
- Hébergeur HDS contractualisé

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given a data transmission, When encrypted, Then TLS is enforced (no plaintext HTTP)
- Given data at rest, When checked, Then encryption is confirmed (not readable without key)

UC-09-04.title: 📖 [UC-09-04] Gérer les droits RGPD (accès, rectification, effacement, portabilité)
UC-09-04.body:
Epic: EPIC-09

Preconditions:
- Patient demande son droit

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given an access request, When the system processes it, Then all patient data is exported within 30 days
- Given a rectification, When a field is updated, Then the change is logged and previous version archived
- Given a deletion request, When processed, Then identifiable data is removed (retention policy applied)

UC-10-01.title: 📖 [UC-10-01] Concevoir l'architecture technique (stack, routeur, state)
UC-10-01.body:
Epic: EPIC-10

Preconditions:
- Spécification fonctionnelle validée

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given the tech stack chosen, When documentation is reviewed, Then all layers (UI, state, API, DB) are clear

UC-10-02.title: 📖 [UC-10-02] Implémenter le design system et composants réutilisables
UC-10-02.body:
Epic: EPIC-10

Preconditions:
- Design system spec validé (02-design-system.md)

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given the design tokens, When a component is built, Then all visual properties match the spec
- Given a Storybook, When a story is viewed, Then component variants are documented

UC-10-03.title: 📖 [UC-10-03] Planifier les intégrations externes (Maia, e-mail, IA, capteurs)
UC-10-03.body:
Epic: EPIC-10

Preconditions:
- Architecture core définie

Critères d'acceptation:
- Given external integrations, When planned, Then MVP scope is clear (file import) and V2 APIs are identified

pr_template.title: PR: <type>/<référence> - Court résumé
pr_template.body:
Résumé:
- Quel est le changement principal ?

Contexte / problème:
- Pourquoi ce changement est-il nécessaire ?

Solution proposée:
- Description concise de l'implémentation.

Checklist (obligatoire):
- [ ] J'ai lié cette PR à l'issue correspondante (ex: #UC-002)
- [ ] Les tests unitaires associés sont ajoutés/retournent OK
- [ ] La CI passe localement et sur la PR
- [ ] J'ai ajouté la documentation nécessaire (`docs/` ou commentaires)
- [ ] J'ai demandé une revue (assigner au relecteur)
